evals.prompt: I published my Claude Code plugin. How do I get people to find it?
evals.expected_output: Should lead with the official and community marketplaces, citing obra/superpowers going from ~30k to 265k+ stars on marketplace acceptance rather than a campaign. Should give the submission URL and the validation pipeline, and warn that the most common rejection cause is a plugin.json version disagreeing with the CHANGELOG or git tags. Should add awesome-list PRs.
assertions: Leads with registry and marketplace submission
Cites obra/superpowers inflecting on a listing
Names the specific Claude Code awesome-lists

evals.prompt: Our iOS app gets no downloads. We're going to run ads.
evals.expected_output: Should redirect to ASO first, since search drives 65% of iOS discovery. Should name the three levers: keyword relevance, conversion via icon and first screenshots, and quality signals. Should note iOS renders the first three screenshots above the fold and that Apple OCRs and indexes screenshot caption text, so hybrid captions outperform bare UI shots.
assertions: Cites that search drives 65% of iOS discovery
Notes the first two or three screenshots drive conversion
Notes Apple OCRs screenshot captions for keywords
Mentions reviews and update cadence as ranking signals
